truth.acknowledgementBoundaries: What does each acknowledgement prove?HTTP 202 ≠ DB commit ≠ RabbitMQ publisher confirm ≠ consumer ACK ≠ OPC UA method acceptance ≠ PLC accepted ≠ controller succeeded ≠ sensor verification ≠ WMS reconciliation ≠ ERP completion.Each boundary has its own evidence. A lost reply cannot justify another physical pick. Ordinary cell preconditions and authorization are application controls, never certified safety functions.
truth.boundaries: Simulation boundariesHKM1800-inspired visualization built from original procedural geometry. Not Cognibotics CAD or validated HKM1800 kinematics. Not validated robot dynamics or safety-certified. Not SICS AI proprietary software.Synthetic observations come from a deterministic observation model; camera images are not analyzed by computer vision. Workspace and collision preflight are conservative simulation logic. Motion timings are presentation timings, not measured robot performance.Camera controls and replay change only the view. A visible product movement does not prove business completion; verification requires the observation contract.
